new_copy_only_v2.completed_old174_boundary: Every manifest SHA checked; completed batch uses existing small NAS COMMIT/manifest/receipt/tree/range metadata; no old Source stat or rehash. Pending batch alone requires archive174-new exact source identity.

reviewed_offload.NAS_copy_closure: All source-copy bytes SHA; closed NAS full SHA; final Native source SHA; complete target path membership; alias-path full SHA; unchanged backup identities before exact unlink
reviewed_offload.credentials: MANIFEST rawSHA→COMMIT; RELEASE binds manifest/commit SHA and declared allocated/logical release. Earlier Native/cold scientific qualifications remain historical.
reviewed_offload.deletion_scope: Only backup/name entries from fixed initial regular-file/directory inventory. No recursive shell deletion and no foreign namespace deletion.
known_recovery_limits: Existing incomplete target requires explicit recovery; original script does not auto-resume it.

Failure after alias creation but before RELEASE keeps backup or partial backup and truthful NAS COMMIT; plain rerun intentionally refuses missing release. Recovery must use full closed NAS object, not treat partially deleted backup as a complete source.
inactive() checks cmdline/fd/maps but omits cwd. This review does not claim an atomic exclusion against a new writer after scan.
Cold-alias reentry only checks receipt existence/path before return. Future recovery should check the small manifest/commit/release digest chain, without inventing another full body pass.
reviewed_offload.resource_boundary: This offload-specific gate is base5GiB+64MiB and8MiB/s per sequential pass; it is not the production all-project Resources guard. Normal library Resources source unchanged.
